headline: St. Thomas Aquinas pull clear as the last unbeaten side
dek: St. Thomas Aquinas have now met every other member and lost to none of them, and Daemen were the last to try. Molloy's win over Mercy pulls the two level on points behind D'Youville, while District of Columbia, winless in conference play before they beat Staten Island, have not dropped a point since.
